final.memo:
The investment thesis in the Company rests on the announced strategic acquisition, which we view as an event-driven mechanism to unlock value through a combination of personal care and consumer-health products [D01, D07]. Following the definitive agreement signed on November 3, 2025, our focus has shifted from the standalone operating thesis to the execution of the transaction and the realization of the deal consideration [D01, D03]. 

We are currently holding the position as the market pricing reflects a modest gross spread of 4.16%, which accounts for the inherent risks of merger execution and financing [D04]. We remain cautious of the bear case—specifically that merger execution risks or a shift in factor demand could offset the benefits of the acquisition [D05, D06]. The primary risk remains the completion of the deal, as the announced consideration is based on terms that require regulatory approval and the satisfaction of customary conditions [D02, D07].

We will continue to monitor the transaction progress, deal consideration, and the acquirer's leverage as our primary indicators for maintaining or exiting the position [D01, D03]. We do not see an immediate need to adjust the position size until further evidence regarding regulatory hurdles or financing stability becomes available [D07].
